newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica rand strength may be over-adjustment-Stals.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica rand strength may be over-adjustment-Stals.

text.p: Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals said on Tuesday that the rand's recent rally to its strongest levels in six-and-a-half months could be a slight over-adjustment.
"I think there is a little bit of an over-adjustment but what is the right level of the rand?" Stals told Reuters shortly before addressing a media briefing.
Stals said that in the past the right level of the rand would be one where the markets were comfortable with it.
"We must be consistent and we say the same now," he said.
Asked if he thought the markets were comfortable with the rand's present level, he said: "I am not sure."
Earlier the rand was trading at 4.3890/3920 on the dollar after moving below the 4.40 level in after-hours trade on Monday and from 4.4075/4105 late on Monday.
But Stals comments immediately rocked the market and the currency rapidly lost three cents to trade at 4.4320/50 by 1110 GMT.
